_note: Source of truth for the app version (top `version`) and the What's New feed (`releases`). Interim hand-curated; to be generated from Linear 'Release Notes'-labelled issues at build time (see Linear). Item strings are plain text — rendered escaped, no HTML.

items: Accessibility pass (WCAG 2.1 AA): readable text contrast in light and dark themes, full keyboard operation, screen-reader labels, and focus management throughout.
Search is now fully keyboard-operable — arrow keys to move through results, Enter to select — with spoken result announcements.
Tools wired up: Street View (from the parcel panel), Bookmarks, Settings (area units / coordinate format / default basemap), and Report a data error.
Parcel popup no longer overlaps the bottom status bar.
New Tools menu in the top bar: Print, Share, Bookmark, Data Request, Report a data error, Help, What's New, About, and Settings.
Generate Parcel Packet and Compare Parcels available from the parcel popup.
Tax Description and Assessment info windows with plain-language explanations (full AI-driven explainers coming soon).
Mobile overhaul: unified tab bar, split-screen MapBuddy A.I., and a full-screen search experience.
Dark mode with a dark basemap (moon icon in the top bar).
MapBuddy A.I. assistant for asking questions about the map and parcels.
